g.text: Slides small learnable filters over an image to detect local patterns.
💭 Scanning a photo with a small stencil: wherever the picture matches the stencil (an edge, a corner,
a texture), the output lights up.
grid of weights for every input channel. At each position it multiplies the
patch under it by its weights and sums → one output pixel. Every filter produces one
Early layers learn edges and colours; deeper layers combine them into shapes and objects.
Number of filters = number of feature maps produced.
Filter size in pixels (3 is the standard choice).
Step between positions. 2 halves the image size.
Zero border added around the image.
